Save, change, send and delete drafts

## Usage

```text
chainmail draft
```

## Global flags

```text
      --output string   output format: json or table (default $CHAINMAIL_OUTPUT, then cli.toml, then table on a terminal, json otherwise)
      --socket string   daemon socket (default $CHAINMAIL_SOCKET, then cli.toml, then /run/chainmail/chainmail.sock)
```

## Commands

- [chainmail draft create](./chainmail-draft-create.md): Save a new message to Drafts
- [chainmail draft delete](./chainmail-draft-delete.md): Delete a draft (moved to Trash unless policy allows expunge)
- [chainmail draft send](./chainmail-draft-send.md): Send a draft and remove it from Drafts
- [chainmail draft update](./chainmail-draft-update.md): Replace a draft with a new version
